descriptive_title: Grade 1 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Surveys, Tally Charts, and Pictographs (D1.1-D1.5)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 1 unit on data framed around Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel and Tally the Tally Cat. Children sort, tally, build pictographs, order frequencies, and write conclusions about class surveys.
long_description: Open a class of detectives! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 1 unit covers all 5 Data expectations (D1.1-D1.5) through a story-driven detective frame with Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel and Tally the Tally Cat. Day 1 introduces sorting by ONE rule. Day 2 teaches the 4+1 tally cross convention through class surveys. Day 3 builds pictographs with one-to-one correspondence, title, and labels. Day 4 orders categories from greatest to least. Day 5 closes with a Detective Case Capstone where each child runs a full survey case from question through conclusion. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a specific Grade-1 trap: rule-drift, no-cross tally, not-one-to-one pictograph, position-not-count ordering, personal-not-data conclusion), 5 student worksheets with answer keys, 12 paper manipulatives (sortable objects, tally chart, pictograph grid, picture tokens, survey question cards, capstone template, anchor charts, attribute cards, poster, two character puppets), a mid-unit formative check, end-of-unit reflection sheet, class diagnostic checklist, three formative trackers, a 5-row summative rubric on Ontario's 4-level scale, a summative task script, and Junior Data Detective certificates. Pedagogical approach: hands-on data collection with explicit data vocabulary, detective-frame narrative, structured pair work, and consistent character voice throughout the week.
